Variant WLC.PRO.19.7.v001 selected r01, compatible and covering s015; no FALLBACK EXCLUDED mark, so rule 53 does not apply.
The marginal *Or, He pursueth after words, which are nought* was read and set aside under rule 38.

The italic *them* and the italic *with* are separate units under rule 2: the first answers to no morpheme, while the second is licensed by the written `אֲמָרִים` under rule 33, so rule 2's supplied-run clause does not reach across them.
